snippet.title: North Hunt Teaser | Viking Sequel to West Hunt – First Look
snippet.description:
Prepare for the hunt… ❄️

North Hunt is the Viking-era sequel to West Hunt, the multiplayer social deception hit. In this teaser, get your first glimpse of the frostbitten villages, longships, and chaotic gameplay that will challenge your stealth and strategy skills.

🔹 What you’ll see in this teaser:

Viking twist on the classic Chief vs. Thief gameplay

Sneak peeks of unique roles and abilities

Snow-covered settlements, longships, and Norse-inspired environments

The same hilarious chaos West Hunt players loved, now in a brutal Viking setting

🛡️ Wishlist North Hunt on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642850/North_Hunt/
📺 Subscribe for devlogs & updates: @newgenstudio24
